findings.claim: create.sh --level accepts only 1|2|3|3+|phase-parent; the manifest declares review and research as level rows the validation helpers accept
findings.recommendation: accept review/research in the --level case, or delete the two level rows and VALID_LEVELS entries

findings.path: spec-kit-docs.json levels.review.requiredCoreDocs vs templates/{core,addons,packet-types} (no review-report.md.tmpl) + template-utils.sh:191-213
findings.claim: review/review-report.md is required core at review level but has no template anywhere and no versions entry, so copy_templates_batch would hard-fail and TEMPLATE_SOURCE cannot cover it
findings.recommendation: add review-report.md.tmpl or relabel the row as loop-generated

findings.claim: the rule-side resolver maps review+spec.md to review.spec.md.tmpl; the scaffolder resolver special-cases only phase, mapping review spec.md to core/spec.md.tmpl
findings.recommendation: mirror the phase special case in _manifest_template_path or delete review.spec.md.tmpl and the review branch

findings.claim: the renderer writes outputs by template basename at out-dir root, so contract docs like research/research.md cannot land at their packet-relative path; check-files would fail the scaffold; the phase-parent mv hack at template-utils.sh:144-146 is the symptom
findings.recommendation: pass destination names through copy_templates_batch or add a manifest-path lookup to the renderer

findings.claim: DOC_TEMPLATE_NAMES is keyed 'research/research.md' but resolveTemplatePath indexes it by basename, so research.md remains unresolvable in the JS helper after the round-two f-iter006-003 fix (which patched only the bash helper)
findings.recommendation: index the map by basename or pass the full path into the lookup

findings.path: runtime/cli/spec/upgrade-level.sh (create_new_files :1483-1486, :766-806; no implementation-summary occurrence anywhere) vs create.sh:444-452 + spec-kit-docs.json:130-135/511-516/1006-1011
findings.claim: every fresh scaffold writes implementation-summary.md (lifecycle doc), but the upgrade never creates it; an older packet upgraded to L2/L3 can fail check-files FILE_EXISTS once tasks.md has checked items
findings.recommendation: add implementation-summary.md creation to create_new_files, or gate it like FILE_EXISTS does

findings.claim: the 2->3 upgrade materializes decision-record.md and the check-files header says Level 3 = Level 2 + decision-record.md, while the manifest flat model puts decision-record in lazyAddonDocs (flag-scaffolded only); upgraded and fresh L3 packets end up with different file sets
findings.recommendation: drop the create-at-upgrade and rewrite the check-files.sh:13 ladder line, or move decision-record to optionalAddonDocs

findings.claim: the SCAFFOLD_VALIDATION_COUNTS and SCAFFOLD_AI_PROTOCOL_MARKERS blocks are appended only by the scaffolder; the upgrade's render-diff injection never adds them, so upgraded and fresh docs differ in these sections
findings.recommendation: state whether the appended blocks are scaffold-coaching only, or have the upgrade append them

findings.claim: the 'cannot drift from the templates the scaffolder uses' claim holds only for the five mapped docs; implementation-summary.md.tmpl is outside template_for_doc
findings.recommendation: fold into f-iter002-001; make the comment name the five docs or the whole set

findings.claim: the pattern block detects only [YOUR_VALUE_HERE: and [NEEDS_CLARIFICATION:; the templates' dominant left-to-fill class ([context], [Decision Title], [One sentence...], [Yes/No], status pans) survives a scaffold unsubstituted and undetected
findings.recommendation: widen the pattern and pin a rendered-template scan against the substitution list

findings.claim: the blanket [YOUR_VALUE_HERE: ...] -> FEATURE_NAME substitution turns handover's semantic slots (timestamp, blocker_1, resolved/open) into the feature description, so the one detected token class becomes garbage content before the guard can see it
findings.recommendation: restrict the generic substitution; map handover slots per-token or leave them for the guard

findings.claim: [Feature Name] is a token shape neither substituted (the list handles [NAME] and [YOUR_VALUE_HERE:...]) nor detected (pattern block), so a scaffolded implementation-summary keeps a bracketed H2
findings.recommendation: add [Feature Name] to the perl list or normalize the template to [NAME]

findings.claim: [template:level-N/doc.md] provenance tokens survive into scaffolded frontmatter titles; neither the substitution list (targets system-spec-kit/templates/level-N strings) nor the pattern block handles them
findings.recommendation: move the provenance into the SPECKIT_TEMPLATE_SOURCE comment and drop it from titles, or strip at finalize

findings.claim: goal.md's own blockquote two lines under its HVR_REFERENCE comment contains an em dash, violating the hard punctuation ban of the standard it cites
findings.recommendation: replace with a comma/colon; add a punctuation lint to the template parity suite

findings.path: templates/addons/decision-record.md.tmpl:3 (+ goal.md.tmpl:4) vs hvr-rules.md Section 3 (Oxford comma NEVER)
findings.claim: decision-record's description carries an Oxford comma in a four-item enumeration and goal's description a comma before 'and'; both are hard-banned by the cited standard
findings.recommendation: drop the commas; fold into the f-iter004-001 lint

findings.claim: the goal template's Precedence guidance uses a semicolon in visible body boilerplate
findings.recommendation: split the sentence; fold into the lint

findings.claim: the HVR reference's 'Templates That Apply HVR' table names templates/*/implementation-summary.md and templates/level-3*/decision-record.md, paths that do not exist in the flattened template tree
findings.recommendation: correct the two rows to the .tmpl paths or drop the table

findings.path: hvr-rules.md:57-58 (anchors ban) vs templates' ANCHOR: markers (acceptance-criteria.md.tmpl:41, timeline:19, roadmap:19, before-after:19, implementation-summary:82) + goal.md.tmpl:94/acceptance-criteria.md.tmpl:37-38 (natural triples)
findings.claim: the HVR checklist bans <!-- ANCHOR --> comments and exactly-3 enumerations, which the spec-kit sectionGates require and the templates' natural enums use
findings.recommendation: scope the HVR rules (exempt structural anchors and genuine enums) or the two standards cannot coexist

findings.claim: the only spec-named files under sk-doc are 9-11 line validator fixtures with no anchors or required sections; same-named document class as the spec-kit spec template but a divergent shape
findings.recommendation: rename/mark the fixtures as validator harness samples and note the canonical shape is spec.md.tmpl
